description: Create (or reuse) a published card image for a GitHub profile or repository. Returns svg/png URLs and markdown/html embed snippets. Idempotent; counts once against the daily quota.

design.description: a design document from get_template_design or get_card_design, possibly edited; replaces template and palette

format.description: which link to return as url: "svg" (default; best for README embeds) or "png". Both are always in urls

palette.description: background palette id from list_palettes; omit for the template's own background. For any other colour use design

subject.description: GitHub username (e.g. octocat) or owner/repo (e.g. octocat/hello-world)

template.description: template id from list_templates; omit for the subject's default layout

watermark.description: false removes the watermark (Pro only; ignored on Free)

name: create_card
title: Create GitHub card
